taskbar.behavior.hot_corner: Hot corner (touch it to open Start)
taskbar.behavior.auto_hide_conflict: Unavailable while the Windows taskbar is set to "Hidden, shown on edge touch" on the same bottom edge: both would fight for that edge. Set the Windows taskbar to "Hidden" or "Left as is", or move the bar to the top edge.

taskbar.err.native: Cannot change the native Windows taskbar: {detail}

module.wallpaper.desc: Live wallpapers: video, GIF, web pages and Lively wallpapers; pauses itself while you game or run on battery.
module.cursor.desc: Import .ani/.cur cursor sets, preview every cursor, change the size; turning it off brings your old cursors back.

cursor.try.normal: Move the mouse over this box
cursor.scaling_hint: Sharp keeps every pixel (good for pixel-art cursors); Smooth softens the edges when enlarging.
cursor.size_preview: The normal cursor at the chosen size, over your wallpaper
cursor.size_dpi: This is the size at 100% display scaling. On scaled displays (125%, 150%…) the pointer grows by the same ratio.
cursor.game_note: The new cursors work in Windows and in every app that uses the system cursor. Some games, such as League of Legends and Valorant, draw their own cursor in a match; ShunguangDecor never touches games, so your account can't be banned.
cursor.adv_text: Advanced users can still open the original config files.

features.suggest.48822452.name: New battery icon
features.suggest.48822452.desc: Changes the look of the battery icon in the system tray (with its own looks for charging and battery saver). Showing the battery percentage may need another flag that this app does not change. Only matters on devices with a battery. Needs a restart; if your Windows version no longer uses this flag you will see no change.
features.suggest.29532725.name: Sliding taskbar previews
features.suggest.29532725.desc: When you hover an app icon on the taskbar, the window preview slides out in the direction the mouse came from instead of just appearing. Needs a restart; if your Windows version no longer uses this flag you will see no change.
features.suggest.29785184.name: Smaller taskbar buttons when crowded
features.suggest.29785184.desc: Adds a "Show smaller taskbar buttons" setting under Settings > Personalization > Taskbar with three choices: always, never, or only when the taskbar is full. Needs a restart; on Windows versions that already have this setting you will see no change.
settings.title: Settings
settings.follow_os_motion_hint: When on, the app stays still if your system has animations turned off (optimizer apps often do this).
settings.config_text: Export all settings and profiles to one .sgdecor file to move them to another computer. Cursor sets are not included because they may be paid content.
settings.import_body: Your current settings will be backed up to the backup folder, then replaced with the contents of the file.
settings.restore_text: Turns every part off and puts Windows back the way it was before ShunguangDecor. Your saved settings are kept, so you can turn things back on any time.
settings.report_text: Found a problem? Export a report and send it on Discord or GitHub. It contains logs, settings and system information — no personal files.
settings.credits: Built with code and ideas from these open-source projects:

wallpaper.lib.need_enable: Turn the Wallpaper part on to set a wallpaper.

labels.restart.title: Restart Explorer?
labels.restart.body: All open File Explorer windows will close. The taskbar and desktop disappear for a few seconds, then come back. Other apps are not affected.
labels.preview.caption: Your real desktop, captured after applying (names can take a few seconds to update here).
labels.mode.title: Mode
labels.auto.hint: Each file name picks light or dark text from the wallpaper right behind it. With a live wallpaper, the color only changes after the background stays lighter or darker for a moment, so names don't flicker.
labels.custom.fallback_note: The fallback can only change the text color; outline, shadow and backdrop need the DLL inside Explorer.
labels.reason.no_dll: this app build has no DLL
labels.reason.hook_failed: the DLL could not be loaded into Explorer
labels.reason.blocked: the DLL did not connect (an antivirus may have blocked it)
labels.reason.version_mismatch: Explorer holds the DLL of another app version
labels.reason.dll_fault: the DLL hit an error and turned itself off

dialog.restore.features_note: The Hidden Features part is not undone here: open the Hidden Features page and press "Undo all".
features.strip.denied: Admin rights not granted. You can try again at any time; only changing features needs them.
features.undo.button: Undo all changes made by ShunguangDecor

features.undo.body: Put {n} configurations back exactly as they were before ShunguangDecor changed them. Some changes only show after a restart.
features.undo.none: There are no changes to undo.
features.all.note: Microsoft does not publish a description for each hidden feature; the name shown is Windows' internal name. "Search the web" opens your browser and searches by ID.
features.all.filter: Quick filter by ID or name
features.all.configured_only: Only features configured on this PC
features.warn.title: Before changing hidden features
features.warn.body: These are unfinished Windows features. Turning them on or off can cause visual glitches or instability, and may need a restart to show. Every change ShunguangDecor makes is recorded and can be undone with the "Undo all changes made by ShunguangDecor" button.
features.col.name: Name
features.store.boot_note: The Boot store only takes effect after a restart.
features.search.placeholder: Enter a feature ID or name
features.search.hint: Type an ID (a number) or part of a name. Only features Windows has named can be found by name.
features.detail.pick: Pick a row in the table to edit it.
features.toast.applied_boot: Applied. Restart your PC for it to take effect.
features.tools.export_hint: Save the feature configurations Windows currently has to a JSON file to inspect or import later.
features.tools.import_hint: Re-apply the configurations in an exported JSON file. Every change is recorded for undo. Priorities held by the system are skipped.
features.tools.fixprio_hint: Move Service-priority configurations to User (like ViVeTool's /fixpriority). Recorded for undo.
features.tools.subs_hint: Features Windows is tracking usage for. "Report usage" sends one usage report to Windows and changes no configuration.
features.disable.title: Undo the changes made by ShunguangDecor?
features.disable.body: {n} configurations were changed. Undo them before turning Hidden Features off, or turn it off and keep the changes?
